integrity: The map count has an independent hand classification, while the core statement is supported by a complete beat-point certificate whose verifier reconstructs all 44 maps and checks every deletion in the current surviving poset.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the canonical six-point minimal finite 2-sphere and four-point minimal finite circle. The exhaustive certificate proves this finite case only; no parameterized mapping-space core theorem is asserted.
title: The finite mapping space from \(X_2\) to \(X_1\) has circle core
